findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "test_security_basics" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: a2a_card_check, email_check, eu_ready_check, fragrance_check, pre_purchase_check, seo_technical_audit, trust_trio · Private data: test_checkout, verify_attestation, seller_reputation, invoice_duplicate_check, migration_compare, api_contract_diff, product_content_impact, reservation_record_check, multilingual_quantity_check · Public sink: vendor_report, email_check, domain_email_health · Destructive: clone_blueprint, incident_timeline.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: a2a_card_check, email_check, eu_ready_check, fragrance_check, pre_purchase_check, seo_technical_audit, trust_trio · Private data: test_checkout, verify_attestation, seller_reputation, invoice_duplicate_check, migration_compare, api_contract_diff, product_content_impact, reservation_record_check, multilingual_quantity_check · Public sink: vendor_report, email_check, domain_email_health · Destructive: clone_blueprint, incident_timeline

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "fragrance_check" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "[PAID $0.15 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Counterfeit-risk signals for a perfume listing: sales channel, price per ml vs indicative floor, fake-listing words, misspelled brand, seller domain trust, EU Safety Gate alerts on the brand, batch code format. low_risk/caution/high_risk." → after: "[PAID $0.15 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Risk signals for a fragrance listing: sales channel, price per ml, listing words, seller domain and EU Safety Gate. Does not authenticate a physical bottle. Provide url, or brand and seller_domain."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
